tasks.notes: Jump over the fence, south of Varrock. The fence is an agility shortcut just north of the hops patch in Lumbridge.

tasks.notes: Chop down a dead tree next to Varrock's south east wall and the Varrock south-east mine.

tasks.notes: Buy a copy of the Varrock Herald newspaper.

tasks.notes:
Give bones to a stray dog.
A stray dog can be found south of Varrock's east bank near Aubury's Rune Shop.
If 2012 Christmas event was completed, feed the pet stray dog which was rewarded from the event:

• Sir Chen Rescoo, a Labrador found in Falador

tasks.name: Pot Stop
tasks.desc: Make a bowl on a potter's wheel then fire it in the pottery oven, all in Barbarian Village.
tasks.notes: Make a bowl, which requires a piece of soft clay, on the pottery wheel then fire it in the pottery oven, all in Barbarian Village.

tasks.name: On the Ragged Edge
tasks.desc: Enter Edgeville Dungeon using the entrance to the south of Edgeville.
tasks.notes: Enter Edgeville Dungeon using the entrance to the south of Edgeville.

tasks.name: Relocation, Relocation, Relocation
tasks.desc: Move your player-owned house portal by talking to the Varrock estate agent.
tasks.notes: Move the player-owned house portal to a different location by talking to the Varrock estate agent which costs 5,000 coins. The house is not lost in the process.

tasks.name: It Belongs in a Museum
tasks.desc: Speak to Haig Halen after obtaining at least 50 Kudos.
tasks.notes:
Speak to curator Haig Halen, who is found on the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) of the Varrock Museum, after obtaining at least 50 kudos.
In order to get 50 kudos, players can use any of the five following methods:
• By cleaning finds (50 kudos)
• By answering a natural history quiz about museum exhibits given by Orlando Smith (or Mark Brodie, who is found at the same location, if The World Wakes is already completed) in the basement (28 kudos)
• By relating details of certain completed quests to Historian Minas (currently 95 kudos)
• By completing the Statue of Dahmaroc for the first time (10 kudos)
• By completing dragonkin related quests and tasks and talking to Mr Mordaut (15 kudos)
A total of 198 kudos can be earned in the Museum.

tasks.name: Journey to the Centre of the Earth Altar
tasks.desc: Enter the Earth Altar using an earth tiara or talisman.
tasks.notes: Enter the earth altar using an earth tiara, earth talisman, or a wicked hood with an earth talisman fed to it.

tasks.name: Jackanory
tasks.desc: Have Elsie tell you a story.
tasks.notes: Have Elsie tell a story by giving her a cup of tea. Elsie can be found on the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) of the Varrock Saradominist church in north-east Varrock, and a cup of tea can be bought or stolen from the tea stall in south-east Varrock.

tasks.name: Limey
tasks.desc: Mine some limestone near Paterdomus, the temple to the east of Varrock.
tasks.notes: Mine some limestone at the Silvarea mining site, west of Paterdomus.

tasks.name: Sherpa's Delight
tasks.desc: Catch a trout in the river to the east of Barbarian Village.
tasks.notes: Catch a trout in the River Lum to the east of Barbarian Village which requires feathers or having at least the tier 3 featherless fly fishing prawn perk unlocked in the aquarium in player-owned house.

tasks.name: King of the Castle
tasks.desc: Find the highest point in Varrock.
tasks.notes:
Find the highest point in Varrock.
The highest point of Varrock is the Varrock Palace guard tower. This is north-west of the chapel, accessed from the bottom floor by the staircase west of the library. Climbing to the highest point of the Varrock Saradominist church will also count as the highest point.

tasks.name: Stick the Knife In
tasks.desc: Venture through the cobwebbed corridor in Varrock's sewers.
tasks.notes:
Venture through the cobwebbed corridor in Varrock Sewers.
The cobwebbed corridor is past the spiderweb leading to the red spiders in the Varrock Sewers, after walking past the zombies and ghosts.

tasks.name: What Lies Below?
tasks.desc: Take the Dagon-hai shortcut to the Chaos Altar.
tasks.notes:
Take the Dagon'hai's shortcut, Tunnel of Chaos, to the chaos altar. To access the chaos altar, the player will need either a chaos talisman, chaos tiara, omni talisman, omni-tiara, or wicked hood with a chaos talisman added to it.
The entrance to the Tunnel of Chaos is the Saradomin statue west of the earth altar. There are benches next to it. Players may require excavating it prior to entering.

tasks.name: With a Ten-foot Pole
tasks.desc: Get a full complement of rats on your rat pole.
tasks.notes:
Catch six rats using a pet cat whilst wielding a rat pole.
These do not need to be caught in the same house as in the quest - Varrock Sewers is fine.

tasks.name: Can't Make an Omelette
tasks.desc: Escape from the spider lair in Varrock's sewers with some red spider eggs.
tasks.notes: Leave the deadly red spider area in the Varrock sewers after picking up red spiders' eggs. This achievement can be completed by teleporting out. While the sign of the porter effect is active, the eggs will be teleported to the bank directly, preventing the player from completing this achievement.

tasks.name: Point of En-tree
tasks.desc: Use the spirit tree to the north-east of the Grand Exchange.
tasks.notes: Use the spirit tree to the north-east of the Grand Exchange.

tasks.name: Unlocking Your Emotions
tasks.desc: Perform the four emotes from the Stronghold of Security.
tasks.notes:
Perform the four emotes from the Stronghold of Security.
Players must first complete the Stronghold of Security. The four emotes are Idea, Stomp, Flap, and Slap Head.

tasks.name: A Lick of Paint
tasks.desc: Select a colour for a new kitten.
tasks.notes:
Select a colour for a new kitten, costing 100 coins.
Players must wear a ring of charos (a) and charm Gertrude so that they may select the colour of their new kitten. Gertrude will not sell a kitten to the player if they already have a kitten or cat with them or in the bank. However, she does not check the menagerie of the player-owned house.
The act of retrieving a new kitten will reset the current rat kill counter, which may interfere with obtaining the Faster, Pussycat! Kill! Kill! achievement.

tasks.notes: Use the shortcut under the wall, north-west of the Grand Exchange and east of the bridge over the River Lum just south of the Wilderness wall.

tasks.notes: Make a maple plank on the sawmill in Fort Forinthry.

tasks.desc: Pick a fruit from the White Tree.
tasks.notes: Pick a white tree fruit from the white tree in Varrock Palace's garden.

tasks.name: Engage
tasks.desc: Use the hot-air balloon to travel from Varrock to somewhere else.
tasks.notes:
Use the hot-air balloon to travel from Varrock to somewhere else.
Players must unlock the ability to travel from Varrock by voyaging from Entrana to Varrock first, which requires 30 charges. Subsequent voyages only cost 3 charges. The initial travel will not count.

tasks.name: Faster, Pussycat! Kill! Kill!
tasks.desc: Get a cat training medal from Gertrude.
tasks.notes:
Get a cat training medal from Gertrude. This requires getting a pet cat (of any type) to catch 100 rats.
The player's character will say when their cat catches 100 rats. Upon the 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th, and 100th rat caught, a short one-sided dialogue will take place, wherein the player congratulates their cat on the milestone. After the 100th catch, talking to Gertrude will give the medal.
Catching rats with a kitten is significantly slower than with a grown cat, and grown cats will lose their catch count when becoming overgrown. Wily cats have the highest catch rate and are thus highly recommended for this achievement, although these require the cat to age past its regular adult stage and need full completion of the Rat Catchers quest.
Note that obtaining a new kitten will reset the current rat kill counter, so ensure to claim the medal prior to retrieving a new kitten.

tasks.name: Dial V For Varrock

quests: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
tasks.notes:
Teleport to the fairy ring with code DKR which is located west of Varrock.
Dramen staff or Lunar staff are required if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift is not completed yet.

tasks.name: Kudos on the Kudos!
tasks.desc: When you have achieved 153 Kudos, speak to the apprentice by the central staircase, downstairs in the museum.
tasks.notes:
Speak to Orlando Smith (or Mark Brodie during and after The World Wakes) by the central staircase, downstairs in the Varrock Museum, after earning a minimum of 153 kudos.
A player can earn a maximum of 198 kudos in the Varrock Museum activity through 5 different methods:
• by cleaning finds (50 kudos)
• by answering a Natural history quiz about museum exhibits given by Orlando Smith (or Mark Brodie, who is found at the same location, if you have completed The World Wakes) in the basement (28 kudos)
• by relating details of certain completed quests to Historian Minas (95 kudos)
• by completing the Dahmaroc statue for the first time (10 kudos)
• by completing the following requirements and talking to Mr. Mordaut in his office in the basement of the museum. Talking to him on Anachronia will not work (15 kudos)
• Complete both A Tail of Two Cats and Ritual of the Mahjarrat
• Kill the King Black Dragon or obtain Last riders
• Defeat the Queen Black Dragon for the First dragonkin journal
Players can speak to the Information clerk on the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) of the Varrock Museum to receive suggestions on how to receive more Kudos.

tasks.name: Who Ate All the Pie?
tasks.desc: Talk to Romily Weaklax and give him a wild pie.
other: The following is not required if you obtain a wild pie from an eclectic impling:
tasks.notes:
Talk to Romily Weaklax and give him a wild pie.
Romily can be found inside the Cooks' Guild which requires the player to wear one of the following items to be allowed to enter the guild: chef's hat, (modified) sous chef's toque, cooking cape, or max cape.

tasks.notes: Craft an air battlestaff by using an air orb on a battlestaff.

tasks.notes: Use the skull sceptre to teleport to Barbarian Village.

tasks.notes: Talk to the estate agent in eastern Varrock and ask about player housing.

tasks.notes:
Make a Varrock teleport tablet on a mahogany demon lectern or mahogany eagle lectern which requires 1 piece of soft clay, 1 fire rune, 3 air runes, and 1 law rune.
This can be done at another player's house, but an Ironman Mode player cannot use another player's house.

tasks.name: Hand-Me-Downs
tasks.desc: Obtain a new set of Family Crest gauntlets from Dimintheis.
tasks.notes:
Obtain a new set of Family Crest gauntlets from Dimintheis.
Players need to first destroy their previous gauntlets if they still have them and then talk to Dimintheis again. The gauntlets are free to reclaim.
There are 3 variations of the gauntlets; chaos gauntlets, cooking gauntlets, and smelting gauntlets.

tasks.name: Waka-Waka-Waka
tasks.desc: Make a waka canoe near Edgeville.
tasks.notes: Make a waka canoe near Edgeville.

tasks.desc: Cast the Home Teleport spell in the Ancient Magicks spellbook to teleport to Edgeville.
tasks.notes: Use the Home Teleport spell in the Ancient Magicks spellbook to teleport to Edgeville.

tasks.notes: Chop down a magic tree in the Varrock Sewers resource dungeon. The tree has to be fully chopped down; just having obtained logs is not enough.

other:

Incinerate a log with the inferno adze, by cutting a tree in the tree patch in Varrock Palace courtyard. A Firemaking boost will not allow players to wield the inferno adze and activate the adze's special effect.
Growing an oak by planting an acorn is the cheapest method and will grow the fastest. Optionally, a basket of tomatoes can be used to pay the nearby farmer, Treznor, to protect the patch.

tasks.name: Mind Your Back
tasks.desc: Get a member of the Dagon'hai's mind control spells to backfire on him.
tasks.notes:
Tell Sil'as Dahcsnu the player is the leader of the Dagon'hai. After doing so, he will attempt to cast a mind control spell which will then backfire on him.
The Magic level requirement for this achievement cannot be boosted.

tasks.name: Red, Red Pies of Summer
tasks.desc: Bake a summer pie in the Cooking Guild from scratch.
tasks.notes:
Bake a summer pie in the Cooks' Guild from scratch by following the steps below:
Required items
• Pot of flour (sold in the Guild)
• Pie dish (found in the Guild)
• Strawberry
• Watermelon
• Cooking apple (found in the Guild)

subs.html: Make pastry dough by mixing a pot of flour with water by using the pot of flour on the pump and drain.
Use the pastry dough on a pie dish.
Add a strawberry, watermelon, and cooking apple to the shell (in that order).
notes: The cooking apple can be found in the Guild, the rest needs to be brought from outside.

subs.html: Bake the raw summer pie.
notes: The pie must be baked on one of the ranges of the Cooks' Guild. Using the Bake Pie spell inside the Cooks' Guild will not count.
Ranges can be found on the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US) or after having completed the hard Varrock achievements also on the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US).

tasks.notes: Defeat a skeleton at Senntisten altar (or pray at Senntisten altar) with Soul Split enabled.

tasks.notes: Smith 10 unfeathered bane bolts (requires 1 bane bar) and feather them by adding 10 feathers. Both steps must be performed within Varrock.
